explanation: Tamsin Cold Chain moved from Marcus Lindqvist to Dana Okafor on April 14, 2025. The October 1 announcement of a move to Marcus was corrected on October 3, which kept Tamsin with Dana and moved Orrin Mills to Marcus instead, so Dana was still the account manager on October 10, 2025.
